title: Feasible Multi-Asset Optimal Execution under Cash Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2609.27786v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Optimal execution (OE) in multi-asset settings involves complex interactions across assets, particularly through shared capital constraints during portfolio rebalancing. While existing models capture cross-impact and portfolio-level dynamics, they largely overlook the role of explicit cash constraints along the execution trajectory. As a result, the feasibility of execution strategies under limited capital remains poorly understood. In this paper, we extend the classical Almgren-Chriss framework to incorporate intertemporal constraints on expected cash consumption, requiring that the expected cumulative cash spent does not exceed a prescribed budget at every trading period. We show that the resulting multi-asset OE problem can be equivalently formulated as a quadratically constrained quadratic program (QCQP), and further establish that it admits a convex representation under mild conditions. translated_title: 现金约束下可行的多资产最优执行
translated_abstract: 多资产环境下的最优执行（OE）涉及跨资产间的复杂交互，尤其是在投资组合再平衡过程中通过共享资本约束产生的交互。尽管现有模型已能刻画交叉影响和投资组合层面的动态，但它们在很大程度上忽视了执行轨迹中显式现金约束的作用。因此，在有限资本条件下执行策略的可行性仍然缺乏充分理解。在本文中，我们扩展了经典的 Almgren-Chriss 框架，纳入了对预期现金消耗的跨期约束，要求在每个交易期间，预期累计现金支出不超过规定的预算。我们证明了由此得到的多资产最优执行问题可以等价地表述为二次约束二次规划（QCQP），并进一步证明了在温和条件下该问题具有凸表示。这为分析提供了一个易于处理的框架。
tldr: 本文将经典的 Almgren-Chriss 最优执行框架扩展到含跨期预期现金消耗约束的多资产场景，证明该问题可等价表述为 QCQP 且在温和条件下具有凸表示，从而为有限资本下可行的执行策略提供了可求解的分析框架。
en_tdlr: This paper extends the classical Almgren-Chriss framework to multi-asset optimal execution with intertemporal constraints on expected cash consumption, showing the problem can be equivalently formulated as a QCQP with a convex representation under mild conditions, thus providing a tractable framework for feasible execution strategies under limited capital.
